samples.subject: Urgent: Your PayPal Account Will Be Suspended
samples.raw_text: Dear Customer, We have detected suspicious activity on your PayPal account. Click here to verify your identity immediately or your account will be suspended within 24 hours. Verify Now: http://paypal-secure-login.ru/verify
samples.label: phishing

samples.label: phishing
